name: chatgpt-web-next
description: A privacy-conscious ChatGPT desktop container with isolated sessions, egress-network status, downloads, and a local session-safety policy.
author: IronMan-libingxue

scripts.pilot:build: pnpm work-pilot:build && pnpm typecheck && electron-vite build --config electron.login-pilot.vite.config.ts
scripts.pilot:check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm pilot:build && node login-pilot/scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.pilot:dist:mac: pnpm pilot:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.login-pilot.json --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.native-login-pilot:check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test --run tests/native-login-popup-policy.test.ts && pnpm native-login-pilot:test:e2e
scripts.native-login-pilot:dist:mac: pnpm native-login-pilot:build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.native-login-pilot.json --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.work-pilot:check: pnpm work-pilot:typecheck && pnpm test --run tests/chrome-work-pilot-detection.test.ts tests/chrome-work-pilot-state.test.ts && pnpm work-pilot:build
scripts.test:e2e:packaged: CHATGPT_WEB_NEXT_EXECUTABLE='dist/mac-universal/ChatGPT Web Next.app/Contents/MacOS/ChatGPT Web Next' node scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:rosetta: CHATGPT_WEB_NEXT_EXECUTABLE='scripts/run-packaged-rosetta.sh' CHATGPT_WEB_NEXT_ROSETTA_EXECUTABLE="$PWD/dist/mac-universal/ChatGPT Web Next.app/Contents/MacOS/ChatGPT Web Next" CHATGPT_WEB_NEXT_EXPECT_ARCH=x64 node scripts/e2e-smoke.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: ChatGPT Web Next needs camera access only when you choose a ChatGPT camera feature.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: ChatGPT Web Next needs microphone access only when you choose a ChatGPT voice feature.
